description: PLOS's LaTeX template (plos_latex_template.tex of 2026-04-10, with plos2025.bst) from PLOS_latex_template.zip on journals.plos.org (plosone/s/file?id=1457, linked from journals.plos.org/plosone/s/latex). PLOS has no class: the template is article [10pt,letterpaper] with a preamble, so like the conference styles this setting is article plus the template's layout lines. No licence in the zip (kept private). Kept from the template: geometry (top=0.85in, left=2.75in, footskip=0.75in, the wide left margin), changepage, textcomp, marvosym, nameref, lineno [right] (loaded only; \linenumbers is the document's), microtype [nopatch=eqnum] (its \DisableLigatures[f] line is dropped: microtype cannot disable ligatures under XeTeX), xcolor [table], array with the template's + column type and \thickcline/\thickhline, \raggedright with a 0.5cm \parindent, the 5.25in x 8.75in text block, caption with bold labels and a period, 'Fig' as \figurename, the numbered \@biblabel, \bibliographystyle{plos2025} (plos2025.bst shipped), and fancyhdr's footer (page/last page and \today, offset 2.25in into the margin). Left out: cite (General loads natbib or biblatex, and biblatex refuses cite), hyperref (General loads it), epstopdf (a pdfTeX helper), and the template's \lorem/\ipsum demo macros.
